info.prettypipes.fluid_extraction_module:
Pulls fluid from adjacent tanks
Filters and pull rates vary by tier
All tiers prevent over-sending
info.prettypipes.fluid_filter_module:
篩選管道輸入進相鄰容器中的流體
篩選欄位數因等級而異
info.prettypipes.fluid_retrieval_module:
Pulls fluid from other tanks in the network
Filters and pull rates vary by tier
All tiers prevent over-sending
info.prettypipes.fluid_limiter_module:
Limits the amount of fluid that can enter adjacent tank
Automatically prevents over-sending
info.ppfluids.fluid_item.usage: 對流體儲罐使用，以將容器內流體倒入儲罐中。
